日期：1930年3月13日。

情报报告。

祥钟丝织厂 - 贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）850号

1930年1月19日，该厂因市面萧条而停工，工人随即向国民党总部和社会局呼吁复工。结果，国民党与社会局联合要求厂方在1月19日至2月1日期间，向每名工人发放每日40分的津贴。厂方同意了这一要求，并照此支付了款项。然而，关于工厂复工的调解事宜被转介至社会局下属的仲裁委员会，该委员会认定停工理由属实，建议除在2月1日至3月5日期间按每日25分的标准提供救济外，另向每名工人发放15元的遣散费。然而，工人要求100元的遣散费，后将其诉求减至60元，目前事态即如此。厂方否认了有关其提议将遣散费增加至30元的报道。

关于3月5日发生在工厂前的骚乱，次日我们的情报报告中出现的报道已得到法租界警方的证实，可视为对该事件的真实记录。

社会局目前正在调查该事件的相关情况，其代表已拜访法租界警方，并获取了警方掌握的信息。该代表还获准检查了在混战中枪托折断的警用步枪。

File No.
No. I. O. D. 1041.
March. 5, 1930.
2 - 3 - 30.

Fracas in French Concession: Factory workers attack
Police - One demonstrator killed

About 250 employes of the Ziang Chong Silk Weaving
Factory, 850 Rue Amiral Bayle, French Concession, (recently
closed down owing to trade depression) demonstrated in front
of the factory at 8.20 a.m. to-day, March 5, to enforce
a demand for the issue of retiring gratuity of $100.00 each.
On being offered $30.00 by the management they became unruly
and ultimately the Reserve Unit of the French Police turned
out and attempted to pacify them. The crowd resented the
presence of the police and several of the female workers
commenced throwing night soil from commodes on to the Annamite
policemen who formed part of the Unit. When attempting to
relieve the women of their night soil buckets, the Annamites
were set upon by the male demonstrators who were armed with
iron bars. Several attempts were made by the crowd to
relieve the Annamites of their rifles, with the result that
these policemen were forced to fire in the air.

In one instance, however, an Annamite police to prevent
the loss of his rifle, shot his adversary in the abdomen.
This man has since died. In other two cases two Annamites
had the butt of their rifles broken in the struggle. One
or two members of the crowd received minor injuries from
their own fellows during the fray.

It would appear that from 8.20 a.m. until about 10 a.m.
the mob did not display much rowdyism but at the latter hour it is
alleged by the French Police, a shot was fired from a pistol
by some unknown person in the midst of the crowd. From that
moment the crowd became ugly, the fracas, as already outlined,
commencing with the women's attack on the Annamite policemen.
Complete order was restored. Three Annamite policemen are
suffering from minor bruises inflicted by iron bars.

A. C. (Pol). v/3
C. D. I.

1930年3月5日。
1930年3月2日 - 3日。

法租界骚乱：工厂工人袭击
警察 - 一名示威者死亡

1930年3月5日，即今天上午8时20分，位于法租界贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）850号的祥钟丝织厂（近期因市面萧条而停工）约250名员工在工厂前示威，强行要求发放每人100.00美元的遣散费。当管理层提出支付30.00美元时，他们变得不守规矩，最终法租界警方的后备队出动并试图平息事态。人群对警察的出现表示愤慨，几名女工开始将马桶中的粪便泼向作为该部队一部分的安南籍警察。当安南籍警察试图夺走妇女手中的粪桶时，手持铁棒的男性示威者向他们发起攻击。人群多次试图夺取安南籍警察的步枪，导致这些警察被迫向空中开枪。

然而，在其中一起事件中，一名安南籍警察为防止步枪丢失，向对手腹部开枪。此人随后死亡。在另外两起事件中，两名安南籍警察在搏斗中步枪枪托被打断。在混战中，一两名 crowd 成员被同伴造成轻伤。

似乎从上午8时20分到大约10点，暴民并未表现出太多的粗暴行为，但据法租界警方称，在后一时刻，人群中某不明身份者用手枪开了一枪。从那一刻起，人群变得凶恶，如前所述，骚乱始于妇女袭击安南籍警察。秩序完全恢复。三名安南籍警察因被铁棒击打而受轻伤。

A. C. (Pol). v/3
刑事调查处处长（C. D. I.）

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, MARCH 6, 1930

Police Obliged To Use
Arms When Unruly Mob
Attacks Weaving Plant

One Workman Shot Dead, Two Others Hit By
Bullets, And Four Policemen Badly Assaulted
As Result Of Riot In French Town

One Chinese was shot to death and four policemen two French and two Annamites, and, two laborers were seriously injured on Admiral Bayle yesterday morning, when 280 workmen, armed with iron bars and other weapons created a riot in front of a Chinese weaving plant and clashed with the police.

The unruly mob, including several females, broke through the closed iron gates of the plant and destroyed two rifles, taken from the hands of the Annamites, who were badly beaten up. Soon after two French constables, who were called to the scene, were obliged to resort to their arms.

Several shots were fired and the mob soon dispersed, leaving behind them the four badly assaulted policemen, and three of their comrades, who were hit by bullets.

The injured were immediately rushed to the St. Marie's Hospital. One of the laborers, fatally injured, succumbed to his wound before he received surgical treatment.

The whole trouble dates back to December 20, last year, when the Ziang Chong Weaving Factory on 850 Amiral Bayle closed down their plant owing to heavy losses in business. This created a sensation among the 287 laborers, who, thus thrown out of work, demanded a fair remuneration of $70 for each hand from the owners.

The question of gratuity presented a delicate problem when the owners offered only $30. Finally the Chinese Municipality was requested by the workmen to solve the problem. After investigations held by the Municipality and Kuomintang authorities, the gratuity was cut to $45 each for each regular hand.

Unsatisfied with the new offer, the laborers demonstrated before the plant for the past few days, when negotiations failed once again to solve an amicable settlement with the owners. As a precautionary measure, the French Police were called, while the entrance to the plant was closed.

At 8.20 a.m. yesterday the mob gathered again on Rue Amiral Bayle, and suddenly attacked the plant, forcing open the gates. Using iron bars and other weapons, the angry men and women assaulted the two Annamite policemen, who barred their entrance with rifles. The rifles, however, were soon destroyed. Seeing their imminent danger, the French police constables who were also on duty in the plant, resorted to their pistols, but before they could open fire, the mob had come upon them. Fortunately the constables managed to use their arms finally, and the mob was subsequently dispersed. The four injured policemen together with the three laborers were rushed to the St. Marie's Hospital, where one workman succumbed to a fatal wound.

The police were seriously hit in their heads, while the other two laborers, one man and a woman, received injuries in the leg and thigh respectively. The latter are expected to recover shortly.

It was learned late last night that the matter had been left in the hands of the Chinese Municipality, who are expected to settle the incident pending five days' investigation.

（批：I understand that the French Police withheld official information from press, & this account & that in U.N.D. news were obtained from other sources — Chinese witnesses, etc
J.R.）

（印：POLITICAL BRANCH (FOREIGN SECTION) 6 - 3 - 30 Who.）

《字林西报》，1930年3月6日，星期四

当无序暴民
袭击织造厂时
警察被迫使用
武器

法租界骚乱导致
一名工人被枪杀，两人中弹，
四名警察遭严重殴打

昨天上午在贝勒路（Admiral Bayle），一名中国人被枪杀，四名警察（两名法国人和两名安南人）以及两名劳工受重伤，当时280名工人手持铁棒和其他武器在一家中国织造厂前制造骚乱并与警察发生冲突。

包括几名女性在内的无序暴民冲破了工厂关闭的铁门，并毁坏了从安南人手中夺走的两支步枪，这些安南人遭到毒打。不久后，两名被召至现场的法国巡捕被迫使用武器。

数声枪响后，暴民很快散去，留下了四名遭受严重殴打的警察，以及三名中弹的同伴。

伤者立即被送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital）。其中一名劳工伤势致命，在接受手术治疗前身亡。

整个纠纷源于去年12月20日，位于贝勒路850号的祥钟织造厂因业务亏损严重而关闭工厂。这在287名因此失业的劳工中引起了轰动，他们向业主索要每人70美元的公平报酬。

当业主仅提供30美元时，遣散费问题成为一个棘手的问题。最后，工人们请求中国市政府解决这一问题。经过市政府和国民党当局的调查，遣散费被削减为每名正式工45美元。

由于对新提议不满，过去几天工人们在工厂前示威，此时谈判再次未能与业主达成和解。作为预防措施，法租界警方被召来，同时工厂入口被关闭。

昨天上午8时20分，暴民再次聚集在贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle），并突然袭击工厂，强行打开大门。愤怒的男女使用铁棒和其他武器袭击了两名持步枪阻挡其进入的安南籍警察。然而，步枪很快被毁坏。看到迫在眉睫的危险，也在工厂执勤的法国巡捕使用了手枪，但在他们开火之前，暴民已逼近他们。幸运的是，巡捕最终得以使用武器，随后暴民被驱散。四名受伤的警察连同三名劳工被紧急送往圣玛丽医院，其中一名工人因致命伤身亡。

警察头部受到重创，而另外两名劳工，一男一女，分别腿部和 thigh（大腿）受伤。后者预计不久即可康复。

昨晚深夜获悉，此事已交由中国市政府处理，预计将在五天的调查后解决该事件。
